title: Automatically redact PII in images with Amazon Nova
facebook: Want to share a photo without worrying about your licence number or boarding pass being visible? Amazon Nova can automatically blur personal details before you send it. https://aiworldhq.com/article/how-to-hide-personal-details-in-photos-before-sharing-them #privacy #photos
